header.helpSubtitle: Everything you need to know about RTS services.

helpSections.title: About RTS Act 2015
content: The Right to Service (RTS) Act 2015 ensures timely delivery of government services to citizens.
This portal provides easy access to municipal services under the RTS Act.
Citizens can apply, track applications, and access information 24/7.

helpSections.title: How to Use This Portal
content: 1. Login using your mobile number and OTP verification.
2. Choose the desired service from the dashboard.
3. Fill out the multi-step dynamic application form.
5. Review, save draft, or submit the application.
